native_harness.behavior: passes the full prompt token batch to llama_decode after llama_set_adapter_cvec

pinned_llama_cpp.qwen3_behavior: build_cvec(cur, il) is applied to the post-FFN residual tensor before the next transformer layer
pinned_llama_cpp.ggml_behavior: binary add permits the 1D source tensor to repeat/broadcast across higher dimensions of the layer tensor

finding: The current native llama.cpp cvec path and the credited PyTorch forward-hook path are aligned in model family, hidden dimension, layer identity and additive residual direction, but they are not intervention-equivalent in token scope: PyTorch perturbs only the last token while native cvec broadcasts the layer vector across the prompt-token residual tensor.
epistemic_boundary: A positive native cvec result may retain native model-specific causal component credit, but it must not be described as a strict replication of the PyTorch last-token intervention unless token-scope equivalence is separately demonstrated.

hypothesis.statement: The selected internal direction is sufficiently robust that LAST_TOKEN_ONLY and ALL_PROMPT_TOKENS interventions preserve the same directional and matched-control specificity pattern.

counterhypothesis.statement: Native success depends materially on broadcasting the vector across earlier prompt-token states, so agreement with the PyTorch witness is mediated by a different intervention mechanism rather than strict carrier replication.

cheapest_high_information_discriminator.phase_0: No new unusual experiment before canonical create-only atomic coordination.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.comparison_1: PyTorch LAST_TOKEN_ONLY vs PyTorch ALL_PROMPT_TOKENS isolates token-scope effect without changing model weights/runtime family.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.comparison_2: PyTorch ALL_PROMPT_TOKENS vs native cvec isolates runtime/quantization/carrier transfer with intervention scope better matched.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.classification_rule: If comparison_1 materially diverges while comparison_2 agrees, classify native success as BROADCAST_SCOPE_CARRIER_REPLICATION, not LAST_TOKEN_INTERVENTION_REPLICATION.
